text.description_html:
Grandeur PSHNOL, Large New Orleans 3 x 19-5/8 Push Plate

The New Orleans Push Plate is based on the Russwin design from the early 1900's. It was and still is very popular in the French Quarter of New Orleans's jazz clubs, restaurants and high end homes. The rope border and ornate detailing make this one of the most elegant pushplates available today. Its long length makes it great for larger doors. The Large New Orleans 3 x 19-5/8 Push Plate is cast in high quality brass and offered in your choice of 5 different luxurious finishes that highlight every detail. It is packaged with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.

Also available: Small New Orleans Push Plate

Click here to see the entire Grandeur Nostalgic Warehouse Collection

Specifications of Grandeur New Orleans Push Plate

  • Width: 3"
  • Height: 19-5/8"
  • Material: Solid Brass



** This item is being discontinued. Very limited quantities available.
